design.input: integer codes x (post-quantizer, grid g = eps / 2^G), L per cycle; the v0.1.8 ingest quantizer is not in the RTL
design.configuration: fixed by the host (shape, T, G, predictor; no config search in hardware); eps bits and times / meta varints are host-composed header segments streamed through
design.scope: S4DI v1, rank 0, relations off, zero / last / linear hold, D <= 2^ADDR_W = 2048, G <= 16
design.microarchitecture: as v0.1.15 scp4d_tenc_p (S0 accept + read issue -> S1r registered read -> S1a predict / residual / deadband -> S1b q / reconstruction / write -> S2a sizing -> S2b accumulators + record write -> S3 close; 4-entry record FIFO; emitter START + sparse 1 / 2 events per cycle at W <= 2 / W = 4 or dense W elements -> 32-byte queue, append iff queue + staged <= 32 - MA, MA = 7 / 10 / 20), with a short emitter path: the record carries its first event's gap and >= 128 flag (computed in S2b), later events of a record use lane - previous lane - 1, q varint lengths sit at a 4-bit stride, and bytes are placed by explicit offset / lane selectors (no variable shift, no constant x variable product)

error_codes.6: register overflow (pred, residual or reconstruction leaves signed 32 bits)
error_codes.8: host header beat overruns its segment (or 0 / > W bytes)

design.cycle_count: from the start cycle (1) to the cycle done is observed, inclusive (testbench count); full rate = a code beat and a header beat offered every cycle and out_ready = 1

verdict.keeps_up: No synthesis estimate committed yet: W = 4, L = 8 takes 18527 cycles (0.6514× the W = 2 decoder's 28444).
verdict.bottleneck: W = 4, L = 8 on env T64 is input (codes / cycle)-bound: 18527 cycles = 1.1308× max(T × ceil(D / L), ceil(bytes / W)); the remainder is one START cycle per frame, the frame-pair double buffer (frame t + 2 waits for frame t to be emitted) and sparse records with a single event. Below L = 8 every configuration is input-bound (the encoder must read every code, unlike the event-driven decoder).
verdict.loop: Closed loop W = 4, L = 8 -> scp4d_tdec_w W = 4: 19223 cycles end to end (1.0376× the slower standalone run).
